title: General motor ratings for various voltage ranges
headers: Range of Motor rating in kW: Minimum
Range of Motor rating in kW: Maximum
markdown:
| Supply | Voltage | Range of Motor rating in kW: Minimum | Range of Motor rating in kW: Maximum |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 φ AC | 230 V | 0.3 | 2.5 |
| 3 φ AC | 415 V | - | 250 |
|  | 3.3 KV | 225 | 750 |
|  | 6.6 KV | 400 | - |
|  | 11 KV | 600 | - |
| DC | 230 V | - | 150 |
notes: N.B. printed beside the source: When no minimum is given, very small motors are feasible. When no maximum is given very large motors are feasible.
The printed supply symbols are the Greek phi glyph (1 φ AC, 3 φ AC), transcribed as U+03C6; they are not the digit 0 or the letter O.
The Supply cell is empty for the 3.3 KV, 6.6 KV and 11 KV rows; the printed cell borders are present, so the blanks are kept rather than merged into 3 φ AC.
Printed dashes in the Minimum/Maximum cells are retained; they are not read as zero.
Draft only: unit existence in the built index was not checked, because data/build is out of scope for this batch.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi full-page PNGs and 288-300 dpi region crops, with sideways pages rotated upright before reading; no OCR, no native-text values, no paid service
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every cell, power, dash, blank and footnote was read from the image and retained as printed; printed anomalies are listed in notes and were not corrected.
